description: Change an existing link: its destination, slug, note, UTM fields or the disabled flag. Only the fields you pass are changed. Changing the slug changes the short URL, so old copies of it stop working.

disabled.description: true stops the redirect, false turns it back on.

id.description: Link id (UUID) as returned by shorten_url, shorten_urls or list_links.

slug.description: New slug. The short URL changes with it.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign name. Added to the destination URL.

utm_content.description: UTM content (ad or link variant). Added to the destination URL.

utm_medium.description: UTM medium, e.g. email. Added to the destination URL.

utm_source.description: UTM source, e.g. newsletter. Added to the destination URL.

utm_term.description: UTM term (paid keyword). Added to the destination URL.

name: update_link
